description: CRC32C (Castagnoli) golden vectors — the shared seed for cross-language agreement (F#/C#/TS/Rust). Standard CRC32C: init 0xFFFFFFFF, reflected, polynomial 0x82F63B78, final xor 0xFFFFFFFF. The Zeta hardware path (SSE4.2 Crc32 / ARMv8 ComputeCrc32C) and the table form compute the identical value. The canonical check value CRC32C("123456789") = 3808858755 (0xE3069283) anchors correctness. Payloads are byte arrays (0..255); results are uint32 (fit JSON's exact range). Pure integer — fully byte-lockable.
